notes: ZOMBIES RUNS FASTER: the zombies maps had 40 to 80 real lights (lamps, candles, fires, glows) and every one cost every pixel every frame. Now only the 12 that matter most near you are real at any moment and they hand over as you move, so it looks the same and runs much lighter, especially on Macs and laptops.
No more hitches when you pick up story items or a boss appears (the game was recompiling its shaders each time).
Shadows in zombies are redrawn every other frame, and zombies re-plan their path a few times a second instead of every frame (every frame when they are close to you).
